description: Remediation worklist for tools/analysis/audit_plain_vs_shipped.py. "differ": functions whose shipped (post-PostProc) object is not a register-renaming + reschedule of their PostProc-free compile. "sched_branch_copy": functions whose scheduler_normalizer step took a branch displacement from retail instead of from its own permutation. The gate fails only on NEW entries or growth; remove an entry by fixing the C (or demoting to asm_only) and re-running --write-baseline.
